tagline.id: Saya seorang software developer yang berfokus pada pengembangan aplikasi web dan mobile, dengan pengalaman membangun solusi digital untuk mendukung kebutuhan dan proses bisnis.
tagline.en: I am a software developer focused on web and mobile application development, with experience building digital solutions that support business needs and processes.

id: Fullstack developer yang terbiasa dengan sistem berskala perusahaan. Sehari-hari saya mengerjakan modul ERP dengan Laravel dan React, aplikasi mobile React Native untuk tim sales di lapangan, sekaligus menjadi maintainer dan code reviewer lintas proyek.
Saya menempuh pendidikan D4 Teknologi Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak di Sekolah Vokasi IPB University.
en: A fullstack developer experienced with enterprise-scale systems. My day-to-day work covers ERP modules built with Laravel and React, React Native mobile apps for field sales teams, and serving as a maintainer and code reviewer across projects.
I studied Software Engineering Technology (D4, Bachelor of Applied Science) at the School of Vocational Studies, IPB University.

description.id: Saat ini, saya bekerja di Univerz dengan tanggung jawab utama mengelola dan memelihara ekosistem website perusahaan.
description.en: I currently work at Univerz, where my main responsibility is managing and maintaining the company's website ecosystem.

description.en: As a Mobile Developer Intern at PT Mitra Indo Maju, I was responsible for a complete end-to-end overhaul of the mobile app's interface.
